Support Phalanx Duel

Why Support Matters

Phalanx Duel is in pre-alpha active development. Support helps increase delivery capacity for reliability, onboarding, and core game quality.

What Support Funds (Near Term)

  • Reliability work, including reconnect behavior hardening.
  • Playtesting and feedback-response cycles.
  • Documentation and onboarding improvements for players and contributors.
  • Operational hosting and release maintenance.

Transparency

  • High-level roadmap
  • Current status and limitations
  • Detailed engineering backlog
